arxiv-2112-02746.title: Unfairness Despite Awareness: Group-Fair Classification with Strategic Agents
arxiv-2112-02746.creator: Andrew Estornell, Sanmay Das, Yang Liu, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik
arxiv-2112-02746.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Andrew Estornell, Sanmay Das, Yang Liu, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik. The use of algorithmic decision making systems in domains which impact the financial, social, and political well-being of people has created a demand for these decision making systems to be “fair” under some accepted notion of equity. This demand has in turn inspired a large body of work focused on the development of fair learning algorithms which are then used in lieu of their conventional counterparts.

arxiv-2301-12815.title: Genetic Algorithm for determination of the event collision time and particle identification by time-of-flight at NICA SPD
arxiv-2301-12815.creator: Semyon Yurchenko, Mikhail Zhabitsky
arxiv-2301-12815.description: Abstract Particle identification is an important feature of the future SPD experiment at the NICA collider. In particular, identification of particles with momenta up to a few GeV / c \text{GeV}/c by their time-of-flight will facilitate reconstruction of events of interest.

arxiv-2302-02952.title: Fusion of Radio and Camera Sensor Data for Accurate Indoor Positioning
arxiv-2302-02952.creator: Savvas Papaioannou, Hongkai Wen, Andrew Markham, Niki Trigoni
arxiv-2302-02952.description: Abstract Indoor positioning systems have received a lot of attention recently due to their importance for many location-based services, e.g. indoor navigation and smart buildings. Lightweight solutions based on WiFi and inertial sensing have gained popularity, but are not fit for demanding applications, such as expert museum guides and industrial settings, which typically require sub-meter location information.

arxiv-2405-02400.title: Fast and Accurate Algorithm for Calculating Long-Baseline Neutrino Oscillation Probabilities with Matter Effects: NuFast
arxiv-2405-02400.creator: Peter B. Denton, Stephen J. Parke
arxiv-2405-02400.description: Abstract Neutrino oscillation experiments will be entering the precision era in the next decade with the advent of high statistics experiments like DUNE, HK, and JUNO. Correctly estimating the confidence intervals from data for the oscillation parameters requires very large Monte Carlo data sets involving calculating the oscillation probabilities in matter many, many times.

arxiv-2408-14231.title: Simulating Gravitational Microlensing Events by TESS: Predictions on Statistics and Properties
arxiv-2408-14231.creator: Sedighe Sajadian, Atousa Kalantari, Hossein Fatheddin, Somayeh Khakpash
arxiv-2408-14231.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sedighe Sajadian, Atousa Kalantari, Hossein Fatheddin, Somayeh Khakpash. We study the statistics and properties of microlensing events that can be detected by the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite(TESS) based on Monte Carlo simulations. We simulate potential microlensing events from a sample of the TESS Candidate Target List(CTL) stars by assuming different observational time spans(or different numbers of sectors for each star) and a wide range of lens masses, i.e., M l ∈ [ 0.1 ​ M ⊕ , 2 ​ M ⊙ ] M_{\rm l}\in[0.1M_{\oplus},~2M_{\odot}]

arxiv-2512-13461.title: Climate change impacts on net load under technological uncertainty in European power systems Publication type: Letter
arxiv-2512-13461.creator: Luna Bloin-Wibe 1 \orcid 0000-0002-5104-9168, Erich Fischer 1, Leonard Göke 2, Reto Knutti 1, Francesco De Marco 2 and Jan Wohland 3
arxiv-2512-13461.description: Abstract Renewable energy sources play a major role in future net-zero energy systems. However, achieving energy system resilience remains challenging, since renewables strongly depend on weather fluctuations, and future energy systems are subject to major design uncertainty. Existing literature mostly treats these types of uncertainty separately.

britannica-1911-chosroes.title: Chosroes (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-chosroes.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-chosroes.description: Article 'Chosroes' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 6), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Chosroes I., “the Blessed” (Anushirvan), 531–579, the favourite son and successor of Kavadh I., and the most famous of the Sassanid kings. At the beginning of his reign he concluded an “eternal” peace with the emperor Justinian, who wanted to have his hands free for the conquest of Africa and Sicily. But his successes against the Vandals and Goths caused Chosroes to begin the war again in 540.

pmc-10673209.title: Endpoint Detection Based on Optical Method in Chemical Mechanical Polishing
pmc-10673209.creator: Fangxin Tian, Tongqing Wang, Xinchun Lu
pmc-10673209.description: Endpoint detection is an important technology in chemical mechanical polishing (CMP), which is used to capture the material interface and compensate the variations of consumables and incoming wafer thickness. This paper aimed to apply optical detection in metal CMP. An in situ optical measurement system was developed for a 12-inch CMP tool.

pmc-10681608.title: MYLK and CALD1 as molecular targets in bladder cancer
pmc-10681608.creator: Hui Jin, Bin Liu, Xin Guo, Xi Qiao, Wenpeng Jiao, Liman Yang, Xiaosen Song, Yueyue Wei, Tingting Jin
pmc-10681608.description: Bladder cancer (BC) is a malignant tumor that occurs in bladder mucosa. However, relationship between myosin light chain kinase (MYLK) and CALD1 and BC remains unclear. The BC datasets GSE65635 and GSE100926 were downloaded from gene expression omnibus by GPL14951 and GPL14550. Multiple datasets were merged and batched.

pmc-10714418.title: Single-Incision Distal Biceps Tendon Repair With Bicortical Tensionable Locking Button Fixation
pmc-10714418.creator: Zeeshan A. Khan, Benjamin Kerzner, Garrett R. Jackson, Harkirat S. Jawanda, Johnathon R. McCormick, Christopher M. Brusalis, Jimmy J. Chan, Daniel J. Kaplan, Nikhil N. Verma
pmc-10714418.description: Acute, traumatic distal biceps tendon injuries are common among the middle-aged athletic male population. Surgical repair of distal biceps tendon remains the most effective means to restore maximal strength of forearm supination and elbow flexion with relief of antecubital pain.

pmc-10755596.title: Type 1 diabetes prevention and treatment: Time to think outside the box
pmc-10755596.creator: Marcelo Maia Pinheiro, Felipe Moura Maia Pinheiro

pmc-10757204.title: Cross‐kingdom regulation by plant‐derived miRNAs in mammalian systems
pmc-10757204.creator: Linpu Yang, Han Feng
pmc-10757204.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are small noncoding RNA molecules ubiquitously distributed across diverse organisms, serving as pivotal regulators of genetic expression. Notably, plant‐derived miRNAs have been demonstrated to have unique bioactivity and certain stability in mammalian systems, thereby facilitating their capacity for cross‐kingdom modulation of gene expression.

pmc-11693794.title: Factors Affecting the Subjective Health Status of Middle-Aged Retirees in Korea
pmc-11693794.creator: Heakyung Moon, Wonjung Noh
pmc-11693794.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:Countries that are becoming aging societies are struggling to establish financial support policies due to their increasing numbers of retired people. In particular, the increase in middle-aged retirees has been reported as unusual and influenced by various factors.

pmc-12432912.title: Global burden of gastric cancer attributed to high-salt diets: spatiotemporal trends and socio-demographic inequalities from 1990 to 2021
pmc-12432912.creator: Wei Liu, Yang Liu, Hua-Wan Chen, Zhen-Zhen Peng, Kui Liao
pmc-12432912.description: BackgroundGastric cancer (GC) remains a major global health burden. High-salt diets are a key modifiable risk factor, promoting mucosal damage, chronic inflammation, and increased susceptibility to Helicobacter pylori infection. This study aimed to quantify the global, regional, and national GC burden attributable to high-salt diets and assess spatiotemporal trends and socio-demographic disparities from 1990 to 2021.

pmc-12574445.title: Patient Expectations in Allergic Rhinitis Treatment: A Mixed-Methods Study
pmc-12574445.creator: Ana Noreña-Peña, Fernando Mugarza Borque, Jorge Mestre-Ferrandiz, Jesús Diaz Olmo, Vicente F Gil-Guillén, Ramón Rodríguez Pacheco, María Mercedes Rizo-Baeza, Ernesto Cortés-Castell
pmc-12574445.description: IntroductionUnderstanding patients’ expectations and needs regarding allergic rhinitis (AR) treatment is key to improving adherence and outcomes. A patient-centered approach that considers subjective treatment perceptions can provide valuable insights for improving disease management.ObjectiveTo explore the subjective experience of patients with moderate to severe AR regarding their treatment, exploring expectations, needs, and adherence.

pmc-12585720.title: Designing Sustainable Materials for Energy Applications
pmc-12585720.creator: Alicia M Manjon Sanz, Brooke Richtik, Abby Neill, Nabaraj Pokhrel, Mohit Chandra, Michelle R. Dolgos, Valentino Cooper
pmc-12585720.description: Piezoelectric materials generate an electric charge in response to mechanical stress and vice versa. Lead Zirconate Titanate, Pb(Zr1-xTix)O3 (PZT) is the current industry standard and the basis for almost all generators, actuators, sensors and related applications critical in today’s technology. Pb(Zr0.52Ti0.48)O3 shows a piezoelectric coefficient (d33) of 200-600 pC/N.

pmc-13041281.title: Integrating trust into artificial intelligence for medicine: using diabetes as the exemplar disease
pmc-13041281.creator: Mandy M Shao, Agatha F Scheideman, David Kerr, Tien Y Wong, Juan Espinoza, Shahid N Shah, Mohammed E Al-Sofiani, Ashley N Beecy, Dieter Bruno, Elizabeth Healey, Nestoras Mathioudakis, Bin Sheng, Michael P Snyder, Yih Chung Tham, David C Klonoff
pmc-13041281.description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to impact healthcare across multiple domains. In diabetes, a complex chronic disease affecting 600 million people globally, AI is already being used from primary care to tertiary specialist care to reduce patient and clinician burden.

pmc-13048996.title: Genetic analysis of key players in PI3K signaling cascade of colorectal carcinoma
pmc-13048996.creator: Hira Pervaiz, Nosheen Masood, Parvez Azam Malik, Jahangir Sarwar Khan, Mumtaz Ahmad Khan, Hassaan Malik
pmc-13048996.description: Triggering PI3K signaling cascade is most common in human cancers. This study aimed to screen the association of seven SNPs and two hotspot mutations, clinical outcome and therapeutic potential with susceptibility to colorectal carcinoma (CRC). In this case-control study of 495 CRC and 495 controls, seven SNPs were genotyped by ARMS-PCR.

pmc-13060745.title: Exploring the Role of Dairy Consumption on the Growth and Development of Canadian Children: Protocol for a Longitudinal Mixed Method Research
pmc-13060745.creator: Karim Karbin, Mojtaba Shafiee, Zoe L Longworth, Adam Baxter-Jones, Marta C Erlandson, Ginny Lane, Ling-Ling Tsao, Walter L Siqueira, Hassan Vatanparast
pmc-13060745.description: BackgroundChildhood is a critical period for physical and cognitive development, in which nutrition plays a fundamental role. Dairy products, rich in calcium, vitamin D, and high-quality protein, are essential for bone health, body composition development, and cognitive performance. However, evidence on the long-term impact of dairy consumption on children’s growth and development, particularly in the Canadian context, is limited.

pmc-13180151.title: The effect of industry-related air pollution on pulmonary function: A prospective, cross-sectional comparative study of industrial proximity and smoking status
pmc-13180151.creator: Celalettin Korkmaz, Mehmet Uyar, Şeyma Şahin, Büşra Ünal, Bekir Sunay, Ömer Faruk Aydos, Basel Shaqdeh, Fatih Alptekin, Recep Şaban Üner, Ali Aydınoğlu, Zeynep Nisa Derviş, Rumeysa Zehra Urhan
pmc-13180151.description: ObjectiveAmbient air pollution is a leading global environmental health risk, significantly contributing to the burden of chronic respiratory diseases and premature mortality worldwide. Despite being a major industrial and agricultural hub, the specific impact of long-term exposure to urban and industrial pollutants on pulmonary function in the Central Anatolian region remains insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13188025.title: Daily increment of residual liver regeneration (DIRER) predicts tumor recurrence and mortality after radical hepatectomy for hepatocellular carcinoma
pmc-13188025.creator: Jin Qian, Kehan Ye, Feiyang Ye, Shutong Zhang, Minghao Zou, Yangchi Zhou, Susu Luo, Ningyang Jia, Fuchen Liu, Hui Liu
pmc-13188025.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the third leading cause of cancer-related death globally, with a 5-year recurrence rate of 70% even after curative resection. Liver regeneration following hepatectomy shares molecular mechanisms with tumor recurrence, yet the relationship between early liver regeneration and HCC recurrence remains unclear.

pmc-13268800.description: estimated to account for 30% of all ILD [1]. pmc-13336075.title: Developmentally Inspired Bioprinting of Nascent Multicellular Human Heart Tissue Through In Situ Differentiation and Morphogenesis of iPSCs
pmc-13336075.creator: Ankita Pramanick, Juhi Chakraborty, Orlaith Kennedy, Hey Wei Wong, Sogol Kianersi, Daniel Kelly, Vasileios Sergis, Abhay Pandit, Andrew C Daly
pmc-13336075.description: Current approaches to heart tissue bioprinting typically rely on using human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)‐derived cardiomyocytes that are pre‐differentiated in 2D culture. This differs fundamentally from embryonic heart development, where mesodermal progenitors differentiate into cardiomyocytes within 3D, matrix‐rich, and shape‐morphing microenvironments.

pmc-13407863.title: Prediction of ocular length in hypotony condition: a measurement study using immersion ultrasound biometry and Dino-Lite® microscope in goat eyes
pmc-13407863.creator: Umar Mardianto, Andi Arus Victor, Prasandhya Astagiri Yusuf, Vetnizah Juniantito, Aria Kekalih, Tri Rahayu, Alhadi Bustamam, Lukman Edwar, Dewi Liputadika
pmc-13407863.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Biometry examination before cataract surgery is crucial to determine intraocular lens (IOL) power. It is mainly influenced by the measurement of eyeball axial length (AXL) and anterior chamber depth (ACD). The hypotony condition shortens these two parameters. The study was conducted to find an appropriate formula that can be used to correct the measurement of AXL and ACD in hypotony conditions. This was a prospective pre-post-experimental study in goat eye.

pmc-13415976.title: Trait‐Based Drivers of Host Specificity in Freshwater Mussel–Fish Parasitic Interactions
pmc-13415976.creator: Irene Sánchez González, Andrew W Park, Krista A Capps
pmc-13415976.description: Species interactions, particularly parasitism, are fundamental drivers of biodiversity and ecosystem function. Life history strategies, defined by differences in reproductive output, growth, and lifespan, play a key role in shaping host–parasite relationships. Freshwater mussels (Family: Unionidae) are a diverse and highly imperiled group that rely on an obligate ectoparasitic larval stage on host fishes.

uslaw-usc-t49-s44708.description: United States Code, Title 49 (Transportation); Part A (Air Commerce And Safety); Subpart iii (Safety); Chapter 447 (Safety Regulation).
